integrity: The proof independently derives the finite extreme-point envelope and the derivative phase diagram. A bundled numerical checker replays the vertex and scalar optimizations but is supplementary to the continuum proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to exponent p=4 and the complementary strongly skew range on the Day--James hexagonal plane. The already-published weakly skew branch is not rederived as a new result, and no claim is made for other exponents.
title: Strongly skew quartic von Neumann--Jordan profile on the Day--James hexagon
